title: The Heretic's Library
text: A library of forbidden books, kept under lock and ward by a Court that calls itself holy. The shelves go up into darkness. Some of the books are chained. Some of them are breathing. The librarian dozes at his desk, keys at his belt.

options.label: The wisest reads while the librarian sleeps, careful not to wake the books.

outcomes.text: The books hold things the Pact does not want known, written very carefully in a hand that shook.
Something in the book reads back. It finds them very interesting indeed.

options.label: Steal the oldest book. Knowledge this forbidden must be worth a fortune.

outcomes.text: It is worth a fortune. It breathes in the pack, and they will come for it.

options.label: Let the librarian sleep, and the books with him.

outcomes.text: He smiles in his sleep. On the step outside lies a single page blown free, which the Leader reads before they can stop themself.

options.label: The Abjurer reads the warded shelf, eager to learn how its wards were made.

outcomes.text: The wards are old. The Abjurer learns how they were made by taking them apart, then wears what is left.
